q: At what age do girls grow fastest?
At about 11 years (8 cm per year).
At what age do boys grow fastest?
At about 14 years (9 cm per year).
Compare the growth patterns of girls and boys.
Both have a growth spurt, but girls’ starts about 2 to 3 years earlier; boys’ peak is slightly higher and lasts longer.
A 13-year-old girl is taller than a 13-year-old boy. Use the data to explain why he may end up taller.
At 13 she is past her peak (growth slowing to 4.5 cm a year) while he is just entering his spurt (8.5 cm a year, still rising), so he will gain more height over the next 3 years.
